mapper.sql: p.policy_id as "policyId", p.field_key as "fieldKey", p.privacy_grade as "privacyGrade", p.encryption_required_yn as "encryptionRequiredYn", p.masking_rule as "maskingRule", p.log_exclusion_yn as "logExclusionYn", p.change_reason as "changeReason", p.updated_at as "updatedAt", p.updated_by as "updatedBy"
mapper.select:
select from privacy_field_policies p
order by p.field_key limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into privacy_field_policies (field_key, privacy_grade, encryption_required_yn, masking_rule, log_exclusion_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{fieldKey}, #{privacyGrade}, #{encryptionRequiredYn}, #{maskingRule}, #{logExclusionYn}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (field_key) do update set privacy_grade = EXCLUDED.privacy_grade, encryption_required_yn = EXCLUDED.encryption_required_yn, masking_rule = EXCLUDED.masking_rule, log_exclusion_yn = EXCLUDED.log_exclusion_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
